Opera has officially relaunched its Air browser, featuring an updated design focused on anti-distraction and mindful web use.

Originally introduced in early 2025, the new version adds Air Soundscapes with four moods, scheduled breathing exercises, guided neck stretches, and automatic dark mode.

It also retains practical tools including a built-in ad blocker, free VPN, and a sidebar with optional ChatGPT integration unchecked by…
